title: Activating Device Control Policy Rules, Configuration, and Indexed Documents Changes

blocks.text: You must activate any changes made to device control policy rules, endpoint configurations, and indexed documents for them to be enforced.
To activate changes made to device control policy rules, configurations, or indexed documents:

blocks.item: Go to Analytics > Endpoint Data Scan > Activation.

blocks.text: The Activation menu allows you to activate the device control policy rules that you added or edited, as well as any modifications made to the Configuration and Indexed Documents tabs.
The Activation menu displays the Activation Status for Policy, Configuration, and Indexed Documents changes as follows:

blocks.item: No Activations Pending: When you have activated your changes.
Pending Activation: When you have saved your changes but not activated the changes.

blocks.text: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) pulls the policy every 15 minutes.
